title: Scripture and Wisdom
definition: Scripture and Wisdom means God’s Word teaches believers how to live with reverence, discernment, humility, and faithfulness before the Lord.
summary: Scripture and Wisdom means God’s Word teaches believers how to live with reverence, discernment, humility, and faithfulness before the Lord.
christFocus: Jesus is the wisdom of God, and Scripture leads believers to walk wisely in dependence on Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Wisdom is more than intelligence or life experience. Biblical wisdom begins with the fear of the Lord and learns to see life according to God’s truth. Scripture teaches believers how to choose, speak, work, love, suffer, and worship wisely.

The Word gives wisdom for ordinary life. It addresses anger, money, relationships, temptation, speech, justice, humility, diligence, and dependence on God. Scripture forms the kind of person who can walk faithfully in complicated situations.

Christ is the wisdom of God. He shows wisdom not only in teaching but in the cross, where God’s saving wisdom overturns human pride. Scripture and wisdom leads believers to trust Christ over self-reliance.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people are overwhelmed by decisions and competing advice. Scripture gives wisdom that is deeper than trends, stronger than impulse, and safer than self-trust.

This doctrine also helps those rebuilding life after addiction, failure, or hardship. Wisdom teaches not merely what to avoid, but how to walk in a new way before God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek wisdom from Scripture before relying on instinct, pressure, or emotion. Ask God for wisdom, listen to His Word, receive correction, and choose the path that honors Christ even when it is costly.
